extracted.intended_audience: general educated readers; scholars of Herbert Spencer; editors/compilers of collected essays
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance implicit in the preface about preparing a final edition of a collected essays volume: selecting which pieces to include, arranging them, and performing substantive and verbal revisions (additions, omissions, postscripts, verification of references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes to essays (omissions and additions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes have been made in many of the essays: in some cases by omitting passages and in other cases by including new ones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use selective omission and inclusion when preparing a new edition; revise essays by removing outdated or unsuitable passages and by adding new material where appropriate. Example cited: many essays altered by omissions/additions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantial recasting / bringing essays up to date
rubrics_metrics.description: Especially the essay on 'The Nebular Hypothesis' ... though unchanged in essentials, has been much altered by additions and subtractions, and by bringing its statements up to date; so that it has been in large measure re-cast.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where necessary, go beyond minor edits to substantially rework an essay to reflect current knowledge or correct earlier formulations, while retaining essential argument where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verification of references and quotations
rubrics_metrics.description: It differs in having undergone a verification of its references and quotations, as well as a second verbal revision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check and verify all references and quotations during editorial preparation to ensure accuracy and reliability for the final edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Second verbal revision
rubrics_metrics.description: It differs in having undergone ... a second verbal revision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform at least one thorough second pass of copy-editing (verbal revision) to improve phrasing and correct errors after substantive changes have been made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrangement: compromise between chronological and topical order
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether to follow the order of time or the order of subjects was a question ... I eventually decided to compromise — to follow partly the one order and partly the other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assembling disparate essays, balance chronological order and thematic grouping: group volumes by dominant themes but within volumes arrange essays approximately in chronological order so far as consistent with subclassing and thematic coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volume thematic grouping and within-volume ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: The first volume is made up of essays in which the idea of evolution ... is dominant. In the second volume essays dealing with philosophical questions, with abstract and concrete science, and with aesthetics, are brought together ... The ethical, political, and social essays composing the third volume ... Meanwhile, within each volume the essays are arranged in order of time; not indeed strictly, but so far as consists with the requirements of sub-classing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define clear thematic criteria for each volume (e.g., evolution, philosophy/science/aesthetics, ethics/politics/social) and order essays within volumes roughly by date while respecting subclassing/subject grouping constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criteria for exclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Beyond the essays included in these three volumes, there remain several which I have not thought it well to include — in some cases because of their personal character, in other cases because of their relative unimportance, and in yet other cases because they would scarcely be understood, in the absence of the arguments to which they are replies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exclude pieces that are overly personal, relatively unimportant, or that depend on external arguments/readings (reply pieces) which would make them obscure to readers; provide a list/titles/places of publication of excluded pieces for reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of postscripts for small additions
rubrics_metrics.description: As well as those large additions there are small additions, in the shape of postscripts to various essays — one to 'The Constitution of the Sun,' one to 'The Philosophy of Style,' one to 'Railway Morals,' one to 'Prison Ethics,' and one to 'The Origin and Function of Music:' which last is about equal in length to the original essay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include postscripts as a mechanism to add brief new material or clarifications to existing essays; postscripts may range from short notes to substantial appendices depending on need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of omitted material (append titles/places of publication)
rubrics_metrics.description: But for the convenience of any who may wish to find them, I append their titles and places of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When omitting essays from a collected edition, provide bibliographic details (titles and places of original publication) so readers can locate the omitted works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical publishing/printing considerations noted
rubrics_metrics.description: By the time the original editions of the first two had been sold, American reprints, differently entitled and having the essays differently arranged, had been produced; and, for economy's sake, I have since contented myself with importing successive supplies printed from the American stereotype plates. Of the third volume, however, supplies have, as they were required, been printed over here, from plates partly American and partly English. The completion of this final edition of course puts an end to this make-shift arrangement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be mindful of practical/financial printing and distribution considerations (stereotype plates, reprints, transatlantic plates). When producing a final edition, resolve interim workaround arrangements and consolidate production for consistency.
